gloss: to shorten; to shrink; to reduce

definitions.explanation: To reduce the length or duration of something.
To make something smaller by compressing or contracting it.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{時間|じかん}を{縮|ちぢ}めてください。
{距離|きょり}を{縮|ちぢ}めるために{努力|どりょく}している。
examples.english: I'm working hard to close the gap.

examples.japanese: {首|くび}を{縮|ちぢ}めて{寒|さむ}さに{耐|た}えた。
examples.english: I hunched my neck and endured the cold.

notes:
{縮|ちぢ}める is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to make something shorter or smaller.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: {縮|ちぢ}む (to shrink)
- {縮|ちぢ}む (intransitive): The sweater shrinks.
- {縮|ちぢ}める (transitive): I shorten the time.

ASPECT (ている):
{縮|ちぢ}めている indicates the action of shortening is ongoing.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を{縮|ちぢ}める — to shorten/shrink [thing]
- [distance/gap]を{縮|ちぢ}める — to close [distance/gap]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {時間|じかん}を{縮|ちぢ}める (shorten time)
- {距離|きょり}を{縮|ちぢ}める (close the distance)
- {差|さ}を{縮|ちぢ}める (narrow the gap)
- {身|み}を{縮|ちぢ}める (shrink back, cringe)

FIGURATIVE USE:
{距離|きょり}を{縮|ちぢ}める can mean to become closer emotionally or to catch up in a competition.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {短|みじか}くする: to make short (more neutral)
- {縮小|しゅくしょう}する: to reduce, scale down (formal)
